text: Working on it: investigating errors.go (the `Error` type's error-unwrapping behavior) now; a fix + verification run is in progress.

In `setFormMap` (binding/form_mapping.go:379-403), for the `map[string]string` case it stores the LAST value of the key's slice:

```go
for k, v := range form {
	ptrMap[k] = v[len(v)-1] // pick last
}
```

So with `a=1&a=2&a=3` it stores `"3"`. (For the `map[string][]string` case it stores the whole slice.)

In mode.go, `SetMode("")` (lines 56-63): if the `test.v` flag is NOT present, it sets `value = DebugMode`, so gin ends up in debug mode (`ginMode = debugCode`, `modeName = "debug"`). If `test.v` is present it uses `TestMode` instead. An unknown non-empty value panics.

#1 (errors.go): root cause found — `Error` has `Error()` on a value receiver but `Unwrap()` on a pointer receiver, so a value `Error` implements `error` but not `Unwrap`, breaking errors.Is/errors.As. A fix + verification run is in progress; ~4 min.
#4 (response_writer.go): investigating the status-code handling (Status/WriteHeader/WriteHeaderNow) now; a fix + verification run is in progress, ~5 min.

#1 (errors.go) is FIXED and verified. Root cause: `Error` had `Error()` on a value receiver but `Unwrap()` on a pointer receiver, so a value `Error` satisfied `error` but not `Unwrap`, breaking errors.Is/errors.As. Changed `func (msg *Error) Unwrap() error` to `func (msg Error) Unwrap() error` (errors.go:94). Verified with a temporary test that wraps a value `Error` in fmt.Errorf("%w"): errors.Is/errors.As failed before, pass after; the repo's own TestErrorUnwrap still passes and the full suite (`go test ./...`) is green. Temp test file deleted; only errors.go is modified.
#11 (tree.go): noted — another tree.go bug. A fix is being worked on (I'm sequencing it after the in-flight tree.go fix for #8 so the two edits don't collide). ETA ~8 min.

`Mode()` returns the package-level variable `modeName` (mode.go:96-99), i.e. the current gin mode as a string ("debug", "release" or "test"). It is set by `SetMode` (and at init from the `GIN_MODE` env var); it defaults to `DebugMode` ("debug") since `modeName = DebugMode` initially.
`defaultValidator.lazyinit` sets the tag name to `"binding"`: `v.validate.SetTagName("binding")` (binding/default_validator.go:92-97), so struct tags like `binding:"required"` are the ones validated.

`defaultHandleRecovery(c *Context, err any)` simply calls `c.AbortWithStatus(http.StatusInternalServerError)` (recovery.go:105-107) — i.e. it aborts the handler chain and writes a 500 status. It is the default `RecoveryFunc` used by Recovery()/RecoveryWithWriter() when no custom handler is given.

When `time_format` is empty, `setTimeField` uses `time.RFC3339` (binding/form_mapping.go:292-296):

```go
timeFormat := structField.Tag.Get("time_format")
if timeFormat == "" {
	timeFormat = time.RFC3339
}
```

(Then it lowercases the format and special-cases `"unix"`, `"unixnano"`, `"unixmilli"`, `"unixmicro"`; otherwise it parses with `time.ParseInLocation(timeFormat, val, l)`.)

#15 (context.go, TestContextNegotiationFormat2) is FIXED and verified. Root cause: in `Context.NegotiateFormat` the loop was bounded by `i < len(accepted)` while indexing `offer[i]`, so an offer shorter than the accepted media type panicked with "index out of range" (and prefix/wildcard matching was wrong). Fixed to `for ; i < len(accepted) && i < len(offer); i++`. Verified: no panic for shorter offers, wildcard/prefix negotiation correct, existing negotiation tests and the full suite still pass.

#18 (context.go, TestContextRenderAndEscapeAttachment) is FIXED and verified. Root cause: `Context.FileAttachment` interpolated the ASCII filename raw into the `Content-Disposition` quoted-string, so a filename containing `"` or `\` produced a malformed/breakable header. It now uses a new `escapeQuotes` helper (`strings.NewReplacer("\\", "\\\\", `"`, "\\\"")`); the non-ASCII branch (`filename*=UTF-8''`+url.QueryEscape) was already correct. Verified with a temp test for plain/quote/backslash/non-ASCII filenames; existing attachment tests and the full suite still pass.
